elements_selected.content: Tier 2 fresh-context, cross-model adversarial review of SPEC-034 v0.4.0. Per USDD Constitutional Principle 12 and SPEC-034 §16. Reviewer should be given the spec + prior-art URLs from §1.4 with explicit mandate to find design defects and unstated assumptions, with particular attention to: (a) REQ-3427+CON-3411 Ed25519 signing byte-range and envelope tampering, (b) REQ-3422+ADR-3413 X25519 padding private-key discard verifiability and correlation channels, (c) REQ-3414+ADR-3414 cohort-scoped PRF salt interaction with the age-encryption.org/fido2prf standard, (d) ADR-3415 TOFU residual-leak honesty and unaddressed mitigations, (e) CON-3409 challenge generation and non-verification disclosure. Reviewer must NOT have participated in the v0.3→v0.4 iteration (both prior reviews were same-session).
